authority: Operator-approved during the M2-T10 graph-sourced close. Bug-fix + one-time format migration; not a constitutional amendment.
trigger: The graph-sourced Phase-8 run msca-pf-graph-01 reached n08f (revision) for the FIRST time and its checkpoint-publish skill failed: 'Gate result at .../phase7_budget_gate/gate_result.json has unexpected schema_id: field schema_id is absent (expected orch.gate_result.v1)'.
finding: Latent bug in the gate evaluator, unrelated to the graph work. artifact_schema_specification.yaml (gate_result_schema, lines ~2157-2166) requires EVERY gate result file to carry schema_id: 'orch.gate_result.v1', and mandates MALFORMED_ARTIFACT for a consumer that finds it absent/wrong. But runner/gate_evaluator.py never emitted the field — ALL 13 gate result files across phases 1-8 lacked it. checkpoint-publish (n08f) is the first consumer to enforce the schema, and n08f had never been reached by any prior run, so the non-conformance went unseen until now.

fix_forward.change: Added 'schema_id': 'orch.gate_result.v1' as the first field of the gate_result dict (the evaluator now conforms to its own declared schema). All future gate results are compliant.
fix_forward.constitutional_note: §17.6.3 (gate results written exclusively by the gate evaluator) is upheld and reinforced — the evaluator is now the writer of a schema-complete result.

backfill_existing.scope: 13 pre-fix gate result files backfilled with schema_id: gate_01_result.json + phase_01..07 gate_result.json + phase8 gate_10a/10b/10c/10d/11 _result.json.
backfill_existing.nature: FORMAT-ONLY. schema_id is added as the first key; no status, predicate, evaluated_at, fingerprint, or any decision field is altered. An already-decided result is made to conform to its declared schema — this is not a gate evaluation and forges no outcome.
backfill_existing.why_not_a_1_8_rerun: Operator steer (M2-T10 is a graph TEST whose thesis is already proven by the green Phase-8 chain). A full fresh 1-8 would regenerate all results with schema_id + fresh mtime but re-run the phase 1-6 agents at high cost, reproducing identical content. The backfill achieves conformance without that cost.
backfill_existing.constitutional_note: §17.6.3 forbids SKILLS from writing gate results (to prevent forged outcomes). This backfill is a documented one-time remediation of a required-field omission that changes no outcome; recorded here per §9.4/§12.

known_residual: Phases 3-6 gate results remain mtime-stale relative to the promoted Tier 3 (open-Q #4 = parallel + explicit promote rewrote the Tier 3 files; content is residual-0-identical, only mtime moved). This did not block Phase 8 (it dispatched off the released budget gate) and is not checkpoint-publish's concern. A full fresh 1-8 run would clear it; deferred as a documented cosmetic artifact of the promote path.
effect: n08f reset to pending (n08a-e remain released). On re-run, checkpoint-publish reads schema_id-bearing gate results and should pass, closing Phase 8 fully green on graph-sourced Part B.
